svg.title: Ablation score differences by dataset
svg.desc: Two heatmap panels compare six ablations on 20NG and NYT. Cells show metric-score differences multiplied by 100 relative to each dataset's full run. For ratio metrics, these values are numerically equal to percentage-point changes; TC is not a percentage.
